notes.title: Transition from Early Access to full release!
notes.notes:
Today is a big day, the game finally left the early access stage. 

Everything that we wanted to test and introduce during early access have successfully been introduced over the last weeks. That's why we transitioned to full release today.

We of course will continue to work and improve the game. The next highest priority is finishing all achievements and balancing the items properly.

We're also preparing some halloween related stuff for next month!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30412463/eb40ef22ee3d0535dc1ab1d910afaddaccf74f48.png[/img]

Meanwhile enjoy the release! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hotfix 09 / 17 / 17
notes.notes: Just deployed a hot fix for an issue that resulted in double map loadings in practice mode when you returned from hosting a multiplayer game.

notes.title: Upcoming Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! Here are some information on the next patch coming some time next week:

- item highlighting reworked again, now works as before when directly looking at but way more performant than in the first iteration

- projectiles shot by weapons now also inherit the player's velocity which allows for some more tactitcal play in the sense that the projectiles fly faster when charging someone when shooting

- added footstep sounds for other players so you can eventually hear people approaching you

- two new map themes, medieval and asian inspired themes (in a more humorous way though)

- two new weapons, a butcher knife and a pistol crossbow

We hope you'll like it, see you on patch day!

notes.title: Upcoming Patch
notes.notes:
The upcoming patch will contain quite some stuff.

- Practice Mode (Singleplayer, as mentioned in the previous announcement)
- Item rebalancing (Less risky, less damage, more ammunition, prolonged battles)
- Achievements
- Edited post processing effects
- Adjusted box collision to enable quicker and more direct looting
- Reworked the highlighting system of items/weapons in an optimizing manner

There is no ETA yet but it wont take too long to finish it up (most likely by friday)



After that patch the main focus will be on:

- enabling endgame chat
- adding the ability to rematch in private/friends only lobbies
- option for visible name tags above players
- indicator for how many players are remaining
- adding a display for the achieved place after getting killed
